thesis: ALAB has the economics of an emerging high-quality compounder: rapid revenue growth, strong gross margins, positive cash generation, high reinvestment returns and a strengthening product moat. The current price, however, is slightly above locked Base value and the veto gate remains unresolved on dilution, customer concentration and valuation-driven permanent-loss risk. The committee therefore keeps the name on WATCH rather than authorizing a new position.

evidence.claim: Core score is 73.12 with 100% coverage; the compounder conditions are mechanically met before veto blocking, with fit score 83.1.
Locked valuation is Bear/Base/Bull $50.15/$284.56/$808.46 versus $303.25 current price, making current price about 1.07x Base.
Q2 revenue was $392.4M, +104% YoY, with Q3 revenue guidance of $540M-$560M.
June liquidity was about $1.253B with negligible funded debt and H1 operating cash flow was positive.
Direct-customer concentration remained high and H1 SBC was $112.9M, preserving unresolved concentration and dilution concerns.

counterevidence: The strongest business-quality domains—CP, MT and RF—score well above 75 and support a genuine compounder interpretation.
Net cash and positive operating cash flow make financial distress unlikely.
Bull value is far above current price, so the stock does not require a Bull+ outcome.
Rapid Scorpio and adjacent-product adoption could make the Base path conservative if multi-customer scaling persists.
unknowns: Whether customer concentration declines as Scorpio and Leo broaden.
Whether diluted-share growth and SBC normalize below owner-FCF/share growth.
How ALAB performs through a full AI infrastructure downcycle.
Long-run switching share and gross-margin durability.
falsifiers: A clear resolution of all three unresolved vetoes with stable or improved fundamentals would justify reconsidering a starter/normal position.
A material customer loss, structural gross-margin decline or persistent >5% dilution would strengthen the WATCH/avoid case.
A lower price without thesis deterioration could materially improve AS and EV gates.

key_kpis.name: price/Base value
key_kpis.threshold: below 0.9x or Base value rises materially
